description: Fetches a subreddit's public metadata by name (Reddit's /r/<name>/about data). Returns the subreddit's title, public description, subscriber count, active-user count, creation timestamp, type, and NSFW flag. Example: name='python'.

name.description: Subreddit name WITHOUT the r/ prefix (e.g. 'python'). Required (path parameter).

name: reddit_subreddit_about
title: Get Subreddit Info
